Generator use is prohibited outside the three permitted windows, including other non-quiet hours.

forbidden_contradictions: Generators are allowed whenever quiet hours are not in effect.
Quiet hours and generator hours are identical.
Generators may run continuously from 6 am until 10 pm.

evidence.quote: Quiet hours are from 10 pm to 6 am.
Generator use is allowed only from 7 am to 9 am, noon to 2 pm, and 5 pm to 7 pm.
Generator use is not allowed at other times.

labels.rationale: Quiet hours and generator windows are stated separately. The explicit prohibition outside generator windows also covers parts of the day outside quiet hours.
